newsitem.title: CHINA: Xerox plans big expansion in China.
newsitem.headline: Xerox plans big expansion in China.

text.p: U.S.-based Xerox Corp is planning to boost investment in its four joint ventures in China by $50 million a year over the next few years, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.

The firm would invest $10-$15 million in 1997 to expand business to total document management from the mainstay of photocopying, the newspaper quoted Stephen Lai, vice-president of Xerox Chinese Mainland/Hong Kong Operations, as saying.
The money would be used mostly for market research, it quoted Lai as saying.
Xerox regarded China as its most important potential growth market in the world, Lai told the newspaper.
Business services and publishing and printing solutions were some of the new growth areas Xerox was hoping to tap in China, Lai said.
Xerox had four joint ventures in Shanghai, Wuhan, Suzhou and Shenzhen with a total investment of $45 million, the newspaper said. It gave no further details.
